quests.title: An Arch Under Occupation
quests.text: Our surveyors cannot examine the old arches while Causeway Brigands and Aqueduct Bowmen use them for cover. Defeat five of those brigands and bowmen in all, by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/wraithwood}. I have several complaints about the masonry, and I prefer to deliver them without arrows coming back.
quests.lesson: The hard half of the Causeway: archers among the brigands.

quests.title: The Burn Beneath the Stamp
quests.text: Copperfell's purse forgers used this style of stamp; the new Tithe-Brand burns where theirs left ink. Take a rubbing of the scorched mark at {name:brandscar_cairn}, {dir_from_giver:brandscar_cairn}. Bring me three Siege Bones from Tollroad Skeletons in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields}, after dark. My runesmiths need to compare what the brand does to stone with what it does to a soldier.

objectives.label: Take a rubbing of the brand

quests.lesson: The top belt of the Causeway at night.

quests.title: Collection Ends Here
quests.text: The smiths found the same burn in the bones: {name:toll_taker_senn} pays dead soldiers in branded coin to keep them on duty. At the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, {dir_from_giver:front_broken_causeway/toll_camp}, defeat five Aqueduct Bowmen or Coal-Purse Factors in all; they guard his takings day and night. Kill Senn as well, then turn out the branded toll-box at {name:r20_anchor_078}. I want to see who considers a road full of corpses a sound investment.
quests.lesson: Causeway climax and the main line's chapter 1 climax: a bowman camp, its named normal leader and Senn's toll-box.

quests.title: Good Paper, Bad Company
quests.text: Senn's accounts say more than he ever did: he was paid to keep the road deadly, and his tolls went back to the factors for another branding and another round of wages. A remittance from Paymaster Chirr in The Skyglass Canopy promises more of the same. The bundle came wrapped in a requisition under a seal of The Throng, on paper fit for a fortress pay office. Take all of it to the Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}; paper this good deserves an awkward question, and I'd rather it came from someone whose job it is.
quests.lesson: Main line, chapter 1 (last turn-in): the handoff from Archshadow Post back to the Warmaster.

quests.title: Party: No More Toll
quests.text: Whoever built {name:last_toll_construct} in the {name:front_broken_causeway/toll_fields} {dir_from_giver:last_toll_construct} did solid work and left miserable instructions. Senn is dead, yet the elite war construct still collects his toll from anyone who passes. Gather a party and destroy it; we can admire the craftsmanship once it stops trying to flatten you.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 50 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: An Arrow Too Many
quests.text: Senn's Aqueduct Bowmen are still at work in the {name:front_broken_causeway/gallows_wood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/gallows_wood}, despite the change in management. Defeat five there by day for a bounty. The bounty stands again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in; I've a budget for clearing the road and every intention of spending it.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Causeway: close in on archers.

quests.title: Fit for Borin's Crew
quests.text: You've done work here that will hold, and Borin Splitbolt needs that sort of hand for Gravesalt Escarpment. Speak with him at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights and pass on my report. He'll grumble that I should have sent you sooner; that's his welcome speech.
quests.lesson: Handoff from the Causeway to Gravesalt.

quests.title: No Shoring, No Sense
quests.text: Brine Borers are tunnelling through the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltflats}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltflats}, without a thought for what stands above them. Kill six there by day before another stretch gives way. Even my worst apprentice knew to brace a tunnel, and he once shored up his own beard.

quests.title: Rope with Opinions
quests.text: A line strung between trees ought to help a traveller find the path. In the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/bonewood}, it helps Tomb Widows find supper. Kill six of those spiders after dark; I'd like our crews to finish a night shift under their own power.
quests.lesson: Gravesalt entry by night, in the same outing.

quests.title: Something for the Mortar Crew
quests.text: The mortar crew has asked for Salt Chitin, and for once the request came without a lecture. Bring me three pieces from Brine Borers on the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/blight_terraces}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/blight_terraces}, by day. I'll keep them busy arguing over the mixing trough until you're back.
quests.lesson: The middle belt of Gravesalt by day.

quests.title: Leave the Graves Out of It
quests.text: Brine Witches gather after dark in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, counting salt over the graves. Our ancestors earned their rest, and so did whoever lies there. Kill six of those witches at night before their muttering wakes something we have to bury twice.
quests.lesson: Casters in a sparse swamp: close in fast.

quests.title: Last Pay, Final Notice
quests.text: Last-Pay Archers still loose arrows from the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltroad_cliffs}, which lie {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/saltroad_cliffs}, every night. Defeat five there after dark so our road crews can work. Their paymaster got his money's worth; everyone else has been paying for it ever since.
quests.lesson: Archers on high ground at night.

quests.title: The Whitewall Dead
quests.text: Past the cliffs the salt has built the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, and Last-Watch Mummies walk it by day as if they still had a post to keep. Put six of them down. A dwarf respects a long shift, but not one this long.
quests.lesson: The top belt of Gravesalt by day.

quests.title: The Last Watch Ends
quests.text: Fresh branded pay reaches the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/ossuary_wood}, and the Last-Watch Sentries shoulder their weapons for another night. Destroy five there after dark, then defeat {name:watch_captain_huskell}, {dir_from_giver:watch_captain_huskell}. His roll should tell us who keeps paying for the watch; somebody has to relieve it, and it may as well be you.
quests.lesson: Gravesalt climax: its named normal leader at the heart of the escarpment.

quests.title: Party: Nothing Left to Count
quests.text: {name:salt_counter_witch} sits in the Gravesalt mires, {dir_from_giver:salt_counter_witch}, counting soldiers as entries to spend. Huskell kept them working; she is already adding up what they might fetch. Gather a party and kill the elite witch. I'd like the next count in that mire to come out at nothing.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 60 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Cobwebs Are a Hazard
quests.text: My crews keep finding fresh webs in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tombwood}. Kill five Tomb Widows there at night and collect a bounty. The job is available again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in. I'd sooner budget for you than keep replacing workers' boots with the workers still in them.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, Gravesalt middle belt.

quests.title: The Clerk at the Foot
quests.text: Huskell's roll is no muster list but a page of the Undertithe's own: soldiers from both armies, each name bought back onto duty with branded pay. Odren Vell is written at the foot in fresh ink; the coin has collected its own clerk. Take the page to Eriath Boughwarden in Lethariel, who remembers the old forged bough-seals and whose watchers keep an eye on Chirr's payments in The Skyglass Canopy. He'll need three graceful sentences to agree with me.
